resources.string:
Renaming an app's package identity can break it. Depending on the app:

 • Some apps will not run after a package-name change.
 • Apps may verify their own signing certificate.
 • Google Play services may depend on the original package/certificate.
 • OAuth clients are often registered to the original package + certificate.
 • Firebase configuration may depend on package/certificate identity.
 • DRM systems may reject modified apps.
 • Native libraries may assume the original package.
 • Apps using reflection may break after namespace changes.
 • Split APKs require processing the complete split set.
 • Updating an existing app requires its original signing key.

 The repackaged APK cannot keep the original developer's signature; it will be signed with your own key. Only repackage apps you own or are permitted to modify.
An application with this package name is already installed.\nChoose another package name or uninstall the existing application.
